name: Lama Atallah
title: Corporate trainer and executive communication coach
bio_short: Corporate trainer and communication coach with more than 15 years' experience in government, education and industry. Former advisor in the Canadian federal government. ICF-certified coach. Delivers training in Arabic, English and French.
bio: Lama is a corporate trainer and communication coach with more than 15 years' experience supporting senior professionals across government, education and industry. She has designed and delivered executive training for national ministries, major corporations and public authorities in strategic communication, media handling, emotional intelligence and leadership presence. Her clients in the UAE include ADNOC, DEWA, the Department of Energy in Abu Dhabi, the Roads and Transport Authority, Dubai Police Authority, the Ministry of Interior Affairs, Khalifa University and the National Emergency Crisis and Disasters Management Authority.  Before moving to the UAE, Lama held advisory and training roles in the Canadian federal government, including positions at Health Canada and Human Resources and Skills Development Canada, supporting senior officials with stakeholder engagement, communication strategy and internal training. She is an ICF-certified transformative coach and visiting instructor in strategic communication at Abu Dhabi University.  At ISOC, Lama delivers corporate communication, media training, interpersonal skills and public speaking programmes, together with executive communication coaching. Her trilingual capability in Arabic, English and French makes her particularly effective for training programmes across the MENA region. She holds a Master's degree in communication from the University of Ottawa and a double Bachelor's degree in business administration and sociology. Lama is based in Dubai.
